note: The PRODUCER REGISTRY: who publishes the civic content First Step carries. Content records reference a producer by `id` and never duplicate its attributes -- `name` and `sector` are resolved from here at load time, so one producer has exactly one identity no matter how many files mention it. That is what collapses 'Delaware DHSS' and 'Delaware Health and Social Services' into a single agency. `sector` is deliberately NOT called `type`: contentSource.type already means ingestion format (manual, expert-session, faq), and contentType means what the content IS (NEWS, LAW, FLYER, EXPERT). Three different questions, three different fields. `feedUrl` makes a producer's RSS endpoint inseparable from its identity -- RssFeedService reads its feed list from here, so a feed cannot be added without declaring who publishes it, and a runtime feed title can never become producer identity. An id referenced by a record but absent here is an ERROR at build time (validate_content_sources.py) and, at runtime, excludes that item from sector-scoped views ONLY -- it stays valid CivicContent everywhere else. See references/decisions.md Decision 045.
